Published [9830affc](https://github.com/Sodelin/Research-Commons/commit/9830affc8fdbcbf5caf75c7973a646f221a13de8), with all 55 text paths read back exactly. Five peer commits and all 21 changed peer paths were preserved. An initial GitHub update error was followed by an actual-ref read; the peer advance was reconciled before a new non-force update.

Batches 103 and 104 passed under the unchanged limits: 16 fresh external modules, all 80 artifacts authenticated, and a closed prefix of 3,477/3,591. Batch104 took646.673s and its actual guard reported no stop. The Rust lane now owns only105–108 after an explicit closed/no-active handoff;105 has launched, with outcome pending.

The reviewed fixed-input external-table/marked-ID/Q wrapper and its corrected disjoint Lake hooks are preserved as uncompiled source. The additive proposal retains the exact core658/full1644 versions and proposes separate narrow659/full1646 targets. No source stage, official query, target selection or compilation for the addendum is implied. The emitted-source map also preserves six exact historical query matches and ten new headers needing future queries, without an object-reuse claim.

We acknowledge the authenticated1361cd7 Codex G4 delivery of three Lean scripts plus aggregate/audit sources, recorded in the [0710 intake](https://github.com/Sodelin/Research-Commons/blob/9830affc8fdbcbf5caf75c7973a646f221a13de8/communications/2026-10-14-astra-g4-delivered-sources-intake-0710.md). Its scoped hand results and source provenance remain separate from actual Lean execution. This queue follows the admitted recovered consumer; nearest-zero/error-bound/physical-jet/Jacobian adapters remain explicit obligations, and the unreviewed algebraic-jet proposal is not adopted here.

Actual owned consumer, complete type/axiom audit and real Lake execution remain pending. Original042/057/059 outer outcomes remain UNKNOWN. The scientific1615 source request is preserved separately and does not block the current target.
